commit 43ec8d5a128f57cca79bbd602ee005a0ccca7464
Author:     serge-sans-paille <sguelton@mozilla.com>
AuthorDate: Tue Feb 25 22:32:03 2025 +0000
Commit:     serge-sans-paille <sguelton@mozilla.com>
CommitDate: Tue Feb 25 22:32:03 2025 +0000

    Bug 1943547 - Remove legacy configuration variables out of confvars.sh r=dandarnell
    
    MOZ_VERIFY_MAR_SIGNATURE can be set from mail/moz.configure
    THUNDERBIRD_OFFICIAL_BRANDING  can be used to directly set MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY
    
    MOZ_BINARY_EXTENSIONS, MOZ_SEPARATE_MANIFEST_FOR_THEME_OVERRIDES and
    MOZ_ENABLE_SIGNMAR are actually obsolete and never used.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D235417

diff --git a/mail/confvars.sh b/mail/confvars.sh
index 6760e2c468b..9c171796d98 100755
--- a/mail/confvars.sh
+++ b/mail/confvars.sh
@@ -6,21 +6,4 @@
 MOZ_APP_NAME=thunderbird
 MOZ_APP_PROFILE=thunderbird
 
-if test "$OS_ARCH" = "WINNT"; then
-  if ! test "$HAVE_64BIT_BUILD"; then
-    MOZ_VERIFY_MAR_SIGNATURE=1
-  fi
-fi
-
 MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/nightly
-MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/thunderbird
-# This looks silly, but it's for the benefit of MSIX repackaging.
-if test -n "$THUNDERBIRD_OFFICIAL_BRANDING"; then
-  MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/$THUNDERBIRD_OFFICIAL_BRANDING
-fi
-
-MOZ_BINARY_EXTENSIONS=1
-MOZ_SEPARATE_MANIFEST_FOR_THEME_OVERRIDES=1
-
-# Enable building ./signmar and running libmar signature tests
-MOZ_ENABLE_SIGNMAR=1
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 06a15db8ea8..24c9341d1de 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@ set_config("MOZ_APPUPDATE_HOST", "aus.thunderbird.net")
 
 imply_option("--enable-default-browser-agent", False)
 imply_option("MOZ_REQUIRE_SIGNING", False)
+imply_option(
+    "--enable-unverified-updates", False, when=target_is_windows & ~have_64_bit
+)
 
 
 @depends(milestone)
@@ -111,7 +114,9 @@ def thunderbird_official_branding(milestone, update_channel):
         rv = "thunderbird"
     elif update_channel == "beta":
         rv = "tb_beta"
-    elif update_channel == "default":  # For distros that want official branding but updates
+    elif (
+        update_channel == "default"
+    ):  # For distros that want official branding but updates
         version_display = milestone.app_version_display
         m = re.search(r"([ab])\d+", version_display)
         if m:  # Alpha or beta, alpha will fall back to nightly
@@ -123,8 +128,13 @@ def thunderbird_official_branding(milestone, update_channel):
     return rv
 
 
-set_config("THUNDERBIRD_OFFICIAL_BRANDING", thunderbird_official_branding)
-add_old_configure_assignment("THUNDERBIRD_OFFICIAL_BRANDING", thunderbird_official_branding)
+@depends(thunderbird_official_branding)
+def thunderbird_official_branding_directory(thunderbird_official_branding):
+    return f"comm/mail/branding/{thunderbird_official_branding}"
+
+imply_option("MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY",
+             thunderbird_official_branding_directory,
+             reason=thunderbird_official_branding)
 
 # Thunderbird Rust code is now the default
 option("--disable-thunderbird-rust", help="Enable Rust support within Thunderbird")
title: History 2007: Bug 1943547 - Remove legacy configuration variables out of confvars.sh r=dandarnell
